ShaderNodePreset.Description: Use to separate skin into its two real pigment layers - melanin (tan / depth) and haemoglobin (blood / ruddiness) - and grade each independently. A physiological log-density separation with no equivalent in Flame or Resolve. Skin only; identity at default.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_MelaninHemoglobin

Uniform.Tooltip: Input color space - the pigment separation runs in linear light
Uniform.Name: colorSpace

Uniform.Tooltip: Blend the result with the original
Uniform.Name: mixAmount

Uniform.Tooltip: View the result, or the isolated melanin / haemoglobin pigment map
Uniform.Name: outputMode

Uniform.Tooltip: Melanin amount - the brown tan / depth pigment. Negative lightens, positive deepens the tan.
Uniform.Name: melAmount

Uniform.Tooltip: Haemoglobin amount - the blood / ruddiness pigment. Negative calms redness, positive adds flush.
Uniform.Name: hemAmount

Uniform.Tooltip: Shading / overall skin density (the luminance term). Usually left at 0.
Uniform.Name: densAmount
